terms.gloss: lost, hopeless, past recovery; morally lost, abandoned, profligate
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 4.55: adulēscēns perditus ac dissolūtus (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Verr. 2.3.64: tū omnium mortālium perditissime (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: miser Catulle, dēsinās ineptīre, et quod vidēs perīsse perditum dūcās
phrases.english: poor Catullus, stop playing the fool, and what you see is lost, count as lost
an abandoned and dissolute young man

sources: Lewis & Short: perdo
